# HFUT 2018 volunteer form: historical field contract v1

[简体中文](hfut-2018.zh-CN.md) · [Contribution workflow](README.en.md)

`hfut-volunteer-hours-2018` / `version: 1` covers the inspected historical form's field conversion. **Current institutional acceptance, recognition and maintenance remain unverified.** No institution is known to have adopted this project. The 2018 file is not described as a verified 2026 template.

## Source and verification

- [Official publication](https://gsu.hfut.edu.cn/2018/1025/c2356a186193/page.psp): published 2018-10-25.
- [Official XLSX attachment](https://gsu.hfut.edu.cn/_upload/article/files/10/cd/d04075af4e94ab2e878a12586ef6/3cd06e40-2182-4677-beb7-5b024f24418e.xlsx): retrieved 2026-10-08, 11,334 bytes, sheet `Sheet1`.
- SHA-256: `5102bd275a962545252bf5f8b4398ba2e731a48ef6c21bcfd9e1d3539e2dab1f`.
- Maintainer: `unassigned`. Code review follows repository contribution review; no institutional maintainer is authorized.

The [read-only verification script](verify-hfut-source.py) reads ZIP/XML in memory using Python's standard library. It checks the attachment fingerprint before inspecting selected fields, installs no dependencies and does not retain the original personal examples. The original XLSX is not redistributed because redistribution permission was not established. The [JSON fixture](hfut-2018.anonymous.json) is entirely fictional.

## Fields and metadata

| Source position | Field | Input or conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B2 (B2:C2) | Reporting coordinator / student number | `reporterName/reporterStudentNumber`, preserving student number as text |
| E2 (E2:F2) | Reporting unit (official stamp) | `reportingUnit`; text does not supply an official stamp |
| B3 (B3:D3) | Service location | `serviceLocation` |
| F3 | Service date | `serviceDate`, a real calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| B4 (B4:D4) | Travel record | Required `travelRecord` with outbound and return times |
| F4 | Service time | `serviceTimeRange`, same-day `HH:mm-HH:mm` |
| A5 / A6:A38 | Sequence | One-based sequence |
| B5 / B6:B38 | Student number | `externalId`, text; never substitute a name or login account |
| C5 / C6:C38 | Name | `name`; identical names may have distinct IDs |
| D5 / D6:D38 | Actual service duration | `confirmedMinutes / 60` |
| E5 / E6:E38 | Travel duration | Explicit `travelMinutes / 60`; missing is never zero |
| F5 / F6:F38 | Total duration | Total minutes under the selected policy, divided by 60 |

The observed data area holds 33 rows. This contract rejects larger inputs instead of extending the form or dropping people. H1/H7 restrict the form to one day of one activity. This version requires a single date and a same-day time range, without automatically splitting overnight or separate activities. All metadata and its source reference are required by this converter; this does not claim that the original form implements equivalent software validation.

Service and travel inputs are integer minutes from 0 to 1440. Manual totals may use half minutes. Column headings omit units; the hours wording in H1 and D6=3.5 matching F4=12:30–16:00 support the hours interpretation. Outputs retain that inference as a warning. Planned duration, image counts and login state do not establish service minutes. Values are not rounded before conversion; display precision must not overwrite original minutes.

## Required total policy

H1 describes a one-hour travel threshold. F6 contains `D6+0.5*E6`; the shared formula starting at F7 covers F7:F38 with no threshold. These are different rules. [Original file](https://gsu.hfut.edu.cn/_upload/article/files/10/cd/d04075af4e94ab2e878a12586ef6/3cd06e40-2182-4677-beb7-5b024f24418e.xlsx)

| `totalPolicy` | Behavior | 120 service minutes, 30 travel minutes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `manual-confirmed` | Explicit `manualTotalMinutes` and `manualTotalSourceReference` for every person | Uses the manual value, including zero |
| `documented-threshold` | Add half the travel when travel is ≥60 minutes; otherwise add none | 120 minutes / 2 hours |
| `original-formula` | Add half the travel at every duration | 135 minutes / 2.25 hours |

No policy is the default. A selecting actor, UTC time, reason and ambiguity acknowledgment are required; missing values fail. For 59/60/61 travel minutes, threshold totals are 120/150/150.5 minutes. Original values and references for service confirmation, travel and any manual total remain available. Original formulas are evidence text; output values follow the selected policy.

## Acceptance coverage and limits

[Nine focused tests](../../server/tests/template-contracts.test.ts) cover metadata and six-column expected values, leading zeros, identical names, duplicate identities, all three policies, zero versus missing, 59/60/61 boundaries, dates, capacity, confirmation provenance, immutable inputs and protection of registered versions from caller mutation. Passed on 2026-10-08.

This contract verifies structure and numeric mapping. It does not verify full source-layout fidelity, native Excel/LibreOffice recalculation, stamped handover or institutional-system import. Callers must additionally verify authorization, snapshot association, file format, retained content and the final download. Confirmed rule changes require a new version instead of silently changing v1. Historical exports retain their original contract and selection record.

Outstanding evidence: a current original form, responsible department and maintainer, resolution of the total-policy conflict, confirmation of units/precision, and acceptance of anonymous output. Missing evidence prevents any claim that this is an institution-certified template.
